scope: One fixed ten-pair extension to the complete 231-row replay; combined results contain all fifteen samples per version and no discarded trials. Same frozen production binaries, CPU 0, alternating order, no build/test/source edit during measurement.

plan.status: Fixed before executing the additional trials; no adaptive sample extension.
plan.motivation: Four nonoverlapping slower rows in the first five paired production capability processes, including controls outside arc membership. Preserve the initial adverse evidence and compare all 231 workloads using the exact same binaries.
plan.order: candidate then baseline on even indices; baseline then candidate on odd indices
plan.decision_rule: Review all fifteen samples per variant, preserving every original and new sample. Do not extend sampling again to obtain a favorable result. Persistent substantial regressions require rejection or a separately frozen revised candidate; report-byte identity alone does not admit performance.

limitations: Min/max ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Timing variation is not automatically attributable to endpoint reuse. This follow-up is bounded and final for these binaries; a retention decision still requires review and the separate native check if the tradeoff passes.
